newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin 3wk T-bill avg yield 18.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin 3wk T-bill avg yield 18.2 pct.

text.p: Average yield in an auction of Slovak finance ministry three-week treasury bills on Wednesday rose to 18.196 percent from 15.00 percent in the previous auction of similar bills on June 19, the central bank (NBS) said.
The ministry accepted bids worth 725 million crowns out of the total demand of 3.845 billion crowns. Minimum accepted yield was 17.50 percent, while maximum yield was 18.90 percent.
The ministry does not set an amount on offer in state securities auctions, nor does it set a minimum or maximum limit price on bids.
The ministry on Wednesday also issued a 5.018 billion crown tranche of one-week treasury bills to the central bank's portfolio.

It uses T-bills and state bonds as the main tools to cover the state budget deficit, which widened to 17.790 billion crowns as of July 8, 1997, from 7.177 billion crowns in the January-May period of 1997.
T-bill maturity three weeks three weeks five weeks
